Why Jensen Huang Should Not Be Reinstated as Nvidia's CEO

Nvidia's board has reportedly and wisely closed the door on Jensen Huang’s return, barely a week after boardroom pressure pushed him to resign as chief executive. A dubious outside campaign is still trying to pry it open.
